brief: A three-storey cabinet with at least three drawers.

No true drawer (family drawer on half base) offered by configurator (find_sockets drawer total 0); built closest alternative: three notch drawer frames notch:0#0,-1#notch5, notch:0#0,1#notch1, notch:0#2,-1#notch3 (hex-drawer-frame-notch-fm) at level 0 providing drawer bays, but slide drawers themselves not placed

finish.summary: Built 3-storey 9-cell cabinet (3 levels); drawer family unavailable so installed 3 drawer-frame notches as closest functional alternative; honest partial on drawer count.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
